Alex Morgan

Alex Morgan

Full-Stack Developer & Digital Solutions Architect

Transforming ideas into elegant, scalable web applications with 8+ years of professional experience.

About Me

I'm a passionate full-stack developer with a proven track record of designing and delivering high-impact digital solutions. My journey in tech began with a curiosity about how things work on the web, which evolved into a career spanning startups, agencies, and enterprise environments.

My approach combines technical expertise with a deep understanding of user needs, ensuring that every project I undertake not only meets requirements but exceeds expectations. When I'm not coding, you'll find me contributing to open-source projects, writing technical articles, or mentoring junior developers.

Work Experience

2021 – Present

TechVenture Solutions

Senior Full-Stack Developer

Led the architecture and development of a customer analytics platform serving 500+ enterprise clients. Managed a team of 4 developers and implemented CI/CD pipelines that reduced deployment time by 70%. Improved application performance by 45% through optimization and code refactoring.

2018 – 2021

Digital Design Agency

Full-Stack Developer

Developed 30+ responsive web applications for high-profile clients across finance, healthcare, and e-commerce sectors. Built reusable component libraries and established coding standards that improved team productivity. Mentored 3 junior developers in modern web development practices.

2016 – 2018

StartUp Labs

Web Developer

Contributed to the development of an innovative SaaS platform from concept to launch. Implemented responsive front-end interfaces using React and developed robust backend services with Node.js. Collaborated with product and design teams to deliver features that increased user engagement by 60%.

2015 – 2016

Web Studios Inc.

Junior Web Developer

Built static and dynamic websites using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript for diverse clientele. Assisted in database design and optimization for web applications. Gained hands-on experience with WordPress and improved my understanding of web standards and best practices.
